thread:
rhea (ux): dropped a new layout exploring multi-panel p95 views: left = heatmap, center = p95 small-multiples per route, right = sampling controls + simulate. Trying a compact legend under the chart and inline mini-cta to pin baseline. Mock: https://img.redwood.internal/tmp/multi-panel-p95.png :art:

noah (product): Love the small-multiples idea for route-level visibility. Two asks: 1) allow pinning a baseline at org or team level, 2) make the legend reversible (show metrics first then legend on mobile)

diego (eng): For small-multiples we'll need to lazy-load routes (infinite scroll) and paginate tiles to avoid rendering 100s at once. Backend should provide precomputed p95 tiles for the last 30d. Also: legend under chart is fine but keep it collapsible to save vertical space.

zoe (a11y): Accessibility: ensure each small-multiple has a keyboard focus ring and label like "route /api/generate - p95 312ms". Legend must be operable via keyboard and have aria-controls pointing to charts. Color-only encoding for heatmap intensity fails WCAG; add pattern or numeric overlay option.

rhea (ux): will add a compact "pattern overlay" toggle in the view menu and increase hit targets to 44px. For mobile, swapping legend to top makes sense; I'll add a responsive rule.

noah (product): Sampling controls: label them "Sampling for visuals" and add an auto-suggest button that runs a quick simulation. Default sampling = 100% for new accounts. Simulate modal should show p95 estimate, detection power, and cost delta.

diego (eng): Simulation is costly if naive. Suggest: run approximate replays using cached aggregates and pre-warm for commonly used ranges. Cap simulate to last 14d and show a "more" link if user needs longer. We'll also expose a feature flag simulate-costly=true for early rollouts.

zoe (a11y): Simulate results must be available as a text table and announced to screen readers. If we show a chart in the modal, offer a textual summary and CSV export. Also ensure focus trap in modal and progress updates announced.

rhea (ux): small UX nit: when a user pins a baseline, show a subtle pinned badge on each small-multiple and allow them to compare p95 delta inline. Mock shows "p95 +34ms vs baseline" under each tile. Thoughts?

noah (product): Yes. Also surface a toggle: "persist baseline across sessions" with a tooltip explaining privacy implications (org-level vs personal).

diego (eng): We'll implement baseline persistence with a scope param (org/team/user) and store in user preferences. Watch for querystring deep-linking when baseline pinned. We'll serialize {range, baselineId, sampling} in the URL.

deploy-bot: heads-up: staging deploy scheduled 2026-04-02T05:00Z. Feature flags: small-multiples-lazyload=false, simulate-feature=false by default.

zoe (a11y): color palette: pick a palette that keeps >=4.5:1 contrast for high/low bands when combined with pattern overlay. Keyboard nav: arrow keys to move between tiles, Enter to open route details. Home/End jump to first/last tile.

rhea (ux): will update prototype with collapsible legend, pattern overlay, keyboard nav hints, and the pinned-baseline microcopy. I'll post a video of the interactions and accessibility annotations later today.

diego (eng): i'll add lazy-loading + api for precomputed p95 tiles and wire simulate to cached aggregates with a short TTL. Also will add debounce for scrubber (150ms) and immediate fetch on snap/mouseup.

noah (product): please include telemetry events: simulate_run, baseline_pinned, sampling_changed, small_multiple_opened. We'll need these for feature adoption analysis.

rhea (ux): noted. next steps: update mock, annotate a11y, and handoff. Posting updated prototype and PR links here when ready. :thumbsup:
